data.exact_reserve_text: The return on capacity for the 2012 closed year of account at 31 December 2014 is shown below together with forecasts for the two open years of account.

named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate was impacted by Hurricane Odile which occurred in September 2014 and damaged a port in Mexico. The current gross outstanding is GBP 3.2m. The remaining outstanding movement is primarily made up of smaller attritional claims that fall below the reinsurance recovery threshold.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2014 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 42.677m. Analysis of year-of-account results shows prior-year (pre-2014) years produced a net adverse movement (loss) totalling GBP 11.036m, indicating an overall strengthening of prior year reserves. Key drivers included a 2014 natural catastrophe (Hurricane Odile) and a number of smaller attritional claims below the reinsurance recovery threshold.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' GROSS figure was located. Prior-year development was derived from the year-of-account result table (2012 closed and 2013 open results) in the Managing Agent's report. The technical provisions table shows total gross claims outstanding movements (which include current year movements) and a year-end gross claims outstanding of GBP 71.636m; this creates potential interpretational differences. No gross claims development triangle was present to cross-check prior year development; limited line-of-business reserve movements are disclosed.
